name: orca-ts
description: Orca Ts — TypeScript/Electron fork of Orca livecoding environment

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && pnpm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/sources/links dist/sources/media/fonts && cp sources/index.html dist/sources/ && cp -r sources/links/* dist/sources/links/ && cp sources/media/fonts/* dist/sources/media/fonts/
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -r ~/Documents/Orca-Ts-darwin-x64/ 2>/dev/null; rm -r ~/Documents/Orca-Ts-linux-x64/ 2>/dev/null; rm -r ~/Documents/Orca-Ts-win32-x64/ 2>/dev/null; echo 'cleaned build location'
scripts.build_osx: pnpm run build && electron-packager . "Orca Ts" --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --out ~/Documents/ --overwrite --icon=icon.icns ; echo 'Built for OSX'
scripts.build_linux: pnpm run build && electron-packager . "Orca Ts" --platform=linux --arch=x64 --out ~/Documents/ --overwrite --icon=icon.ico ; echo 'Built for LINUX'
scripts.build_win: pnpm run build && electron-packager . "Orca Ts" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out ~/Documents/ --overwrite --icon=icon.ico ; echo 'Built for WIN'
scripts.build:pack: pnpm run clean ; pnpm run build_osx ; pnpm run build_linux ; pnpm run build_win ; pnpm run add_manual
scripts.push: pnpm run build:pack ; pnpm run push_osx ; pnpm run push_linux ; pnpm run push_win ; pnpm run clean ; pnpm run status
